title: Synthetic Data Fidelity & Validation Asset Library
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (synthetic clinical data / AI test enablement; data-engineering/simulation/governance work, privacy care).

Synthetic-data & digital-twin tools (e.g. Synthea, commercial platforms) and AI/model frameworks integrated at the pattern level; vendor internals cited or deferred, never invented. Regulatory/legal interpretation (HIPAA/HITRUST de-identification, IRB/privacy sign-off, disclosure risk) deferred to privacy/compliance/legal. Never real PHI in a shared harness/twin/AI test env. Automation is Python.
hook: Prove your synthetic data is good enough — and reuse the proof
problem: Synthetic data is only useful if it's faithful enough for the AI use case — and teams need reusable ways to prove it. This solution builds a fidelity and validation asset library: statistical-fidelity and utility metrics comparing synthetic to real, coverage/edge-case checks, and a library of reusable validation assets and test suites — so every synthetic dataset ships with evidence of quality and teams stop re-inventing validation.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the fidelity model: statistical fidelity vs utility vs privacy, coverage/edge cases, and the reusable-asset approach.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (reference statistics/governed real data, synthetic datasets, metrics, environment).
Implementation Guide — define the fidelity/utility metric suite, measure synthetic vs reference, build coverage/edge-case checks, and package reusable validation assets/test suites, pilot-first.

5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
Testing/validation gates (fidelity within tolerance, coverage met, assets reusable) plus Best Practices for a growing validation library.
short: Build a fidelity and validation asset library — statistical-fidelity/utility metrics vs real, coverage checks, and reusable validation assets — so every synthetic dataset ships with evidence of quality. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
